entities.summary: Prudnik is a town in southern Poland, located in the southern part of Opole Voivodeship near the border with the Czech Republic. It is the administrative seat of Prudnik County and Gmina Prudnik. Its population numbers 21,368 inhabitants (2016). Since 2015, Prudnik is a member of the Cittaslow International. Prudnik is a city in Eastern Europe, established around 1255. Holds notable historical significance, documented across 67 language editions of Wikipedia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
